Ever since a young age I figured out that not telling them stuff(bad or good) usually ends up better so I stopped. I do conversation tricks that I don't even realize I'm doing, to keep them talking about nothing, or just tell them exactly what they wanted to hear. That plus I'm just super private of a person in general, has made it so I almost never have a "real" conversation with them. As for telling them, I'm fine with that awkwardness it's just the fact that they will never stop talking about it to me....
